posts.text: Business Overview: Market Cap₹ 2,136 Cr (19-Sep-2026) BHVL (Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd) is the second-largest owner of chain-affiliated hotels and rooms in South India among major private hotel asset owners, operating 9 hotels comprising 1,604 keys across key growth hubs including Bengaluru, Chennai, Kochi, Mysuru, and GIFT City (Ahmedabad). Its portfolio is anchored by long-term operator agreements with global hospitality giants including Marriott International, Accor, InterContinental Hotels Group (IHG), and Hyatt for brand recall, reservations, and loyalty channels.
